This '''unidentified Whiphid''' was a member of the [[Erased]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> along with [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]. In an unneccesary entanglement with [[Ferus Olin]] and [[Trever Flume]] he threw them around with his rather large tusks. After Dex smoothed things out and the rest of the Erased went searching for [[Fy-Tor-Ana|Solace]], he stayed in the bar the Erased roamed in.
